column1: # The el8 packages this spike reads, pinned by checksum.
# glibc is the interesting one: it is where the loader, the ABI-tag note and
# the SONAME all live, and it is the only package in the set whose objects
# carry GNU extensions. rpm and rpm-build are here for two reasons at once --
# they supply a sample of ordinary vendor binaries that glibc's own objects
# are not representative of, and rpm-build is where the elfdeps question is
